title: Seeking Clarifications on Compliance with Foreign Interference (Countermeasures) Act
what_it_is: Seeking Clarifications on Compliance with Foreign Interference (Countermeasures) Act

sections.label: FICA drafting explained
sections.summary: FICA was drafted to deal with foreign actors interfering in domestic politics, as explained during its 2021 passing.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: During the passing of the Foreign Interference (Countermeasures) Act (FICA) in 2021, we have explained that FICA needs to be drafted to deal with the different ways in which foreign actors who want to do us harm can interfere in our domestic politics.

sections.label: FICA levers and guidance
sections.summary: FICA provides levers against threats, and unsure parties can seek legal advice or use the Registry's information kit.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: FICA gives us the levers to prevent, detect and disrupt these threats.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If a PSP is unsure, the normal process will be to take legal advice – this is what people do when they want to know about how a law applies.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They can also refer to the information kit provided by the Registry of Foreign and Political Disclosures.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Home Affairs has been interacting with Members of Parliament, including those from the Workers' Party, giving briefings, answering questions and also responding to feedback.
